findings.body: This assertion can pass even if the cold read never assigns its project: the shared call log already contains the identical metadata update from the worker rounds. The cold-read stub also reuses `thr-stub-1` (`tests/stubs/codex-app-server:22`). Consequently, removing project assignment specifically for cold reads would leave this test green. Capture the calls added by `forge read` and assert that those contain the expected update.

findings.body: The only injected failure is `project/list` during a worker round. No test triggers a failing `thread/metadata/update`, and the cold-read stub always succeeds. Item 2 explicitly requires failed requests to be logged without failing either a round or a read. Add command-level cases with a unique matching project followed by an update failure, and a failing project request during `forge read`; assert successful completion and a diagnostic in that invocation's work log.
